subject: reasoning
question:
Three different positions of the same dice are shown. Find the number on the face opposite to the one showing the number '6'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f81c1fba6eaab0f7776323292c6c417068684da66c3db438efbf8150cc601d0b.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is :-

From the given three different dices the adjacent sides are as shown below :

As 5 is common on both the dices II and III, it is clear that 6, 4, 3, and 2 are adjacent to it, and the remaining i.e. 1 will be opposite to it.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ba07ac93321f581eb142435d1d257330c2e29991a8b0ee81b6ea229c8d67062a.png] 

Opposite pairs:

6 → 3

4 → 2

5 → 1

So, the opposite side of "6" will be side "3".

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
